name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: UI SDK Menu parts with a button trigger: arrow keys, typeahead, checkbox and radio items, submenus, destructive items and async actions.
docs: `DropdownMenuItem shortcut` shows the keys, as UI SDK does, and presses the item when they're pressed while its menu is open (ahead of typeahead). For keys that work while the menu is closed, use UI SDK's data menus (`items`) or `useShortcut`.
